Probably, but I can't confirm it for Bennie. Its listing gives no lunch set-menu price. Room hire is from £50 an hour before 1pm and from £125 an hour after, so a 12:30 start could cost more than the £100 Rebecca guessed. Bennie's other listed set menus are £45 to £63 a head, so £30 may only work for a simpler lunch. Rebecca will need to ask them on Monday.
